<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/ai/tasks/presets/{presetId}/enable"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates it through automations.access as the user: the preset's trigger with the user's changes and one ai_task step. The preset version is recorded so a newer one can be offered later.

  as={"h2"}

>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"The automation's name. Defaults to \"AI · \" and the title.\n"},"title":{"type":"string","description":"The report title. Defaults to the preset's title in the user's language.\n"},"description":{"type":"string"},"trigger":{"type":"object"},"hostSelector":{"type":"object"},"autonomy":{"type":"string","enum":["report","propose"]},"runbook":{"type":"string"},"maxRunSeconds":{"type":"integer"}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
